OK — one replay performance concern: the per-anchor-record `abo` bucket loop `while k*P <= R` — worst case: anchors 8192 × (R/P + 1) appends... For P=1, R=8192: 8192 anchor records → each appends 8193 entries → 67 million entries!! That would be too slow. The protocol says: anchors are 1–8192 records; R ≤ 8192. In the worst case P=1 with all anchors having full range [0,1) — 8192×8193 appends — 67 million appends ≈ 20–60 seconds + massive memory. Need to be smarter: dedupe per phase: anchor coverage per device (anch matrix, P×N bool) already exists — build abo from per-phase device lists: phase_anchor_devs[p] = [devices anchored at phase p] (from union), and abo[t] = phase_anchors[t % P] → build a list of length P just once, and reuse per bucket (no copy needed if treated as read-only!). This also handles duplicates (union). Total work is O(P·… + R) references ✓.
